ee:message.ee:set-payload: %dw 2.0 import * from dw::core::Arrays output application/java var busquedaURN = vars.inputPayload.resource_id splitBy p('parameters.pipe') --- payload filter (($.parametros_bundle some ((item) -> sizeOf((busquedaURN filter ((item.valor splitBy p('parameters.semicolon')) contains $))) > 0 )))

ee:variables.ee:set-variable: %dw 2.0 import * from dw::core::Strings output application/java --- p('directv.d' ++ substring(vars.inputPayload.subscriber_id, 0, 3))
%dw 2.0 import * from dw::core::Strings output application/java --- reverse(substring(vars.inputPayload.subscriber_id, 3, sizeOf(vars.inputPayload.subscriber_id)))

ee:message.ee:set-payload: %dw 2.0 output application/json var busquedaURN = vars.inputPayload.resource_id splitBy p('parameters.pipe') map ($) --- "authorizations_response": busquedaURN map ((item) -> { "urn": item, "access": "true", "max_rating": p('parameters.maxRating'), "ttl": p('parameters.ttl') })

%dw 2.0 output application/json var busquedaURN = vars.inputPayload.resource_id splitBy p('parameters.pipe') map ($) --- "authorizations_response": busquedaURN map ((item) -> { "urn": item, "access": vars.existServices as String, "max_rating": p('parameters.maxRating'), "ttl": p('parameters.ttl') })

%dw 2.0 output application/json var busquedaURN = vars.inputPayload.resource_id splitBy p('parameters.pipe') map ($) --- "authorizations_response": busquedaURN map ((item) -> { "urn": item, "access": "false", "max_rating": p('parameters.maxRating'), "ttl": p('parameters.ttl') })
